subject: Renewal: hybrid tenor + staircase/top-up proposal (auto-renew opt-in)
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acmerobotics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmerobotics.com>, J. Patel <j.patel@acmerobotics.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal timing + capacity plan for Q4-Q5

Hi Vivek —

Our current term with Redwood ends 2026-10-31 and we expect burst needs through Q1 next year due to the Atlas product ramp. We want to discuss a renewal that balances multi-year stability with the ability to top up capacity without renegotiating the whole contract.

Primary asks:
- Multi-year commitment (24 months) with a staircase ramp (year 1 smaller, year 2 larger)
- An auto-renew opt-in for a 12-month continuation unless we explicitly opt out 60 days prior
- A top-up mechanism for incremental GPUs with a simplified pricing ladder (no full contract amendment)

Can you sketch options and any internal approvals needed?

Thanks,
Liam
Head of Cloud Ops
Acme Robotics

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acmerobotics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal timing + capacity plan for Q4-Q5

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the clear brief. I've put together a concise proposal attached (Redwood_Term_Sheet_20260830.pdf) that outlines three paths:

1) Hybrid tenor (24 months) with a staircase: 40% year 1 / 60% year 2 commit; credit top-ups available monthly.
2) Multi-year fixed with pre-negotiated top-up tiers (volume bands) and capped per-token uplift.
3) Shorter 12-month + rolling auto-renew with pre-authorized top-up approval (good if you want flexibility).

Key commercial highlights in the attached:
- Option A (recommended): 24-month hybrid with a one-time onboarding credit and preserved unit pricing for top-ups within agreed bands.
- Auto-renew: opt-in checkbox; opt-out window 60 days before the anniversary.
- Staircase: predefined step increases at months 13 and 19 to match Atlas ramp.

If you like, we can run a quick financial model so you can see burn smoothing vs. cash flow (attached tab in the spreadsheet).

Next steps I suggest:
- Quick sync (20m) this week to agree on a path.
- I'll loop in Contracts once you pick an option; legal review normally 3–5 business days for these templates.

Best,
Vivek
Head of Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Term_Sheet_20260830.pdf, staircase_topup_model_estimate.xlsx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal timing + capacity plan for Q4-Q5

Team —

Forwarding Liam's ask and my proposed recommendation (Option A: 24m hybrid + staircase + auto-renew opt-in). Need guidance on:
1) Discount band for a staircase profile (we typically tier discounts by committed annual spend; is 12–18% reasonable given their growth?)
2) Legal: any clauses we should add for pre-authorized top-up approvals (to avoid separate SOWs every time)?
3) Post-sale: what ramp support (onboarding credits + burst safety net) can we commit to in writing?

I'm aiming to keep this simple — minimize legal friction for top-ups.

-- Vivek

Vivek —

I like Option A but suggest we:
- Offer a stepped discount: 10% Y1 / 14% Y2 (effective blended ~12%) tied to the staircase bands.
- Add a "top-up ladder" appendix that defines three incremental bands (up to 25%, 25–50%, >50%) with pre-agreed per-token uplift; top-ups executed via email acknowledgement from procurement, no SOW required under $50k per event.
- For auto-renew: allow Acme to opt-in at signature; we should include a 60-day notification and one-time price cap for the first auto-renew period.

Karthik / Camila — please confirm legal + CSM feasibility. If legal is comfortable, I'll approve the commercial.

Marissa
VP, Commercial Strategy

We can hop on a 30m call to resolve the redlines; available Thu morning.

- Auto-renew: change default to OFF; we'll provide clear UI checkbox for Procurement to opt-in at signature (compliance- friendly).
